list.title: Invitations
list.signupOpen: Public sign-up is open: anyone can create an account. Invitations assign roles in advance.
list.signupClosed: Public sign-up is closed: only existing users and invited people can get in.

invite.userExists: A user with this email already exists
invite.pendingInvitation: This email already has a pending invitation: resend it from the list
invite.forbidden: You cannot give roles with permissions you do not hold
invite.error: The operation could not be completed
invite.systemLocalHelper: To manage the identity center. Roles are optional.
invite.systemExternalHelper: The person signs in from that system. Pick at least one of its roles.
invite.systemRoleRequired: Pick at least one role of the system
invite.userExistsSystem: They already have an account: to give them access to this system, assign the role on their profile
invite.emailFailed: The email could not be sent (is the mail server running?). The invitation was not saved.
invite.domainNotAllowed: Only emails from {{domains}} can be invited

resend.domainNotAllowed: This email is no longer in the allowed domains
